title: Bayesian trust update contract (L50)
description: Beta(alpha, beta) posterior trust representation. See ADR-060.

invariants.name: beta_representation
must: stored as TrustSignals.<signal>_alpha + <signal>_beta or equivalent struct

invariants.name: prior_beta_2_2
must: operator-tunable to other Beta priors but default pinned

invariants.name: update_formula
invariants.description: alpha += success, beta += failure. No decay here.
must: ADR-037 temporal decay applied SEPARATELY on the point/CI output, not on alpha/beta directly

invariants.name: point_and_ci_exposed
invariants.description: Both point estimate + 95% CI exposed via API.
must: lower and upper bounds returned as tuple

invariants.name: routine_uses_point
invariants.description: ROUTINE/STANDARD risk tier uses point estimate.

invariants.name: high_risk_uses_lower_ci
invariants.description: high_risk uses lower 95% CI for conservatism.
must: explicit lower-CI requirement for irreversible actions

invariants.name: backward_compat
invariants.description: Existing scalar trust APIs still work.
must: downstream code can ignore Beta data and use scalar

out_of_scope: Non-Beta priors per signal type (future ADR)
